items.title: LDAP Enumeration Cheatsheet
items.summary: LDAP enumeration is a key part of a Windows Active Directory assessment. It can do so much, it’s hard to know exactly what to check. It typically requires some auth on the domain, but any user can get almost all of the information. This is the checklist I work through each time I get creds on a domain, starting with quick checks for things like roastable accounts, gMSA passwords, and deleted objects, then looking at ADCS, collecting and analyzing BloodHound data, finding objects I can write to, and digging into individual objects.
